ruleDefinitions.name: Azure Kubernetes Sensitive Role Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies when ClusterRoles/Roles are being modified or deleted. Note: Unmapped fields: operationName

sequences.query: (operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/ROLES\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/ROLES\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/ROLES\/BIND\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/ROLES\/ESCALATE\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/CLUSTERROLES\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/CLUSTERROLES\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/CLUSTERROLES\/BIND\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/CLUSTERROLES\/ESCALATE\/ACTION")
